items.title: Learn T-SQL With Erik: Aligning Queries and Indexes Part 4
items.author: Erik Darling (Erik Darling Data)
items.summary:
In this video, I delve into the intricate world of query and index optimization in SQL Server, focusing on how to align your queries more effectively with existing indexes to achieve better performance. We explore a series of queries that demonstrate both rewriting techniques and index tweaks to highlight the impact of these changes. By running through examples like the "tipping point" scenario, I show you how small adjustments can significantly affect query execution plans and overall performance. Whether you're looking to improve your SQL Server skills or need practical solutions for optimizing your database, this video offers valuable insights and actionable strategies.

items.title: Data Governance in a Crisis: When Every Second Counts
items.author: Confluent Developer
items.summary:
https://confluent.io | What happens when payment systems fail at 2 PM and the team who broke it went home hours ago?

It's Tuesday afternoon. Payment processing is failing across Australia. Customers are angry. The monitoring dashboards show nothing obvious. And the team who deployed the breaking change five hours ago? They're asleep in Europe. This is where data governance transforms from a theoretical checkbox into mission-critical infrastructure. Follow an on-call team as they race against time, using data catalogs, schema registries, and lineage tracking to trace encrypted PII data back through multiple services to find a single missing configuration line. See firsthand why real-time governance isn't just a nice-to-have - it's the difference between a 30-minute fix and a 24-hour disaster.

This video demonstrates how modern data governance tools enable rapid incident response in production environments. Learn why traditional batch-updated governance systems would have left this team with yesterday's schemas and outdated lineage information - potentially turning a quick fix into an all-night debugging session. Discover how concepts like data stewardship, the principle of least privilege, and role-based access control aren't just compliance requirements, but practical tools that help teams solve real problems under pressure.

Technologies covered: Data Catalogs, Schema Registry, Data Lineage, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control), PII Encryption, Real-time Data Governance, Apache Kafka
